title: High Molecular Weight Genomic DNA Extraction from Gram-negative Bacteria for Long Reads Sequencing
author: Baptiste Baptiste Mayjonade
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.r9id94e

steps.title: Inoculate and grow culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate a single colony into 10 mL 10 % TSB (3 g L⁻¹, Fisherbrand™ product code 12186620) and incubate 48 h at 28 °C with shaking at 120 rpm.

steps.title: Pre‑heat lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Heat the lysis buffer for more than 30 min at 65 °C (composition given in the Guidelines).

steps.title: Pellet cells
steps.instruction: Transfer 1.8 mL of the culture to a 2 mL tube and centrifuge at 10 000 g for 5 min.

steps.title: Remove growth medium
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant by pouring it off, taking care to remove all liquid.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 900 µL pre‑heated lysis buffer using a P1000 set to 900 µL; pipette up and down vigorously 10 times with an uncut tip (foam formation is normal).

steps.title: Lysis incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at 65 °C in a dry bath for 20 min, inverting the tube vigorously 10 times after the first 10 min.

steps.title: Brief spin
steps.instruction: Spin the tube for 1 second to collect liquid at the bottom.

steps.title: Add RNase A
steps.instruction: Add 4 µL RNase A (100 mg mL⁻¹, QIAGEN cat 19101) to the lysate.

steps.title: Mix and brief spin
steps.instruction: Invert the tube 10 times, then spin for 1 second.

steps.title: Room‑temperature incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature (18–23 °C) for 10 min.

steps.title: Add potassium acetate
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL 5 M potassium acetate (or 1/3 of the lysis‑buffer volume).

steps.title: Viscous mixing
steps.instruction: Mix by pipetting vigorously 10 times with a P1000 set to 1000 µL; use a tip cut 0.5 cm from the end to minimise shearing.

steps.title: Clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10 000 g for 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the upper phase (~800 µL) to a new 2 mL tube without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Add magnetic beads
steps.instruction: Add 800 µL of bead solution (beads equilibrated at room temperature >30 min and vortexed 30 s) to the transferred lysate.

steps.title: Bind DNA to beads
steps.instruction: Incubate on a rotator at 10 rpm for at least 15 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Collect beads
steps.instruction: Spin the tube for 1 second, place on a magnetic rack and wait 3 min until beads are immobilised and the solution clears.

steps.title: First ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant, add 1 mL fresh 70 % ethanol, close the tube and invert 20 times (or flick) to resuspend beads.

steps.title: Second ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Spin 1 second, keep tube on the magnetic rack, remove supernatant, add another 1 mL 70 % ethanol, resuspend beads as before, spin 1 second and remove supernatant.

steps.title: Final ethanol removal and drying
steps.instruction: Spin to collect droplets, place tube on magnetic rack, remove all ethanol with a P200 or P10 pipette, then air‑dry beads ≤30 seconds.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL Elution Buffer (EB, 10 mM Tris‑Cl, pH 8.5, QIAGEN cat 19086), flick to resuspend beads, incubate 15 min at 37 °C, spin 1 second, place on magnetic rack until solution clears (may require extra buffer or extended time).

steps.title: Collect eluate
steps.instruction: Transfer the clear eluate to a new tube.

steps.title: Assess DNA quality
steps.instruction: Measure concentration with Qubit and Nanodrop; expected Qubit/Nanodrop ratio ≈1.2, concentration 50–200 ng µL⁻¹, A260/A280 1.8–2.0, A260/A230 2.0–2.2. Ratios outside these ranges indicate RNA or other contaminants.

steps.title: Optional RNA removal
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL RNase A (100 mg mL⁻¹) per 100 µL of gDNA solution, mix, incubate 10 min at room temperature (18–23 °C).

steps.title: Check DNA integrity
steps.instruction: Run an aliquot on PFGE or capillary electrophoresis; high‑molecular‑weight DNA should range from ~10–20 kb up to 100–150 kb.

steps.title: Optional bead‑based cleanup 1
steps.instruction: Invert tube 10 times, incubate 10 min at room temperature (18–23 °C), then add 1 volume of freshly prepared bead solution (beads at RT >30 min, vortex 30 s).

steps.title: Re‑assess purity after cleanup
steps.instruction: Measure Qubit/Nanodrop ratios and A260/A280, A260/A230 as in step 11 to confirm improvement.

steps.title: Optional bead‑based cleanup 2
steps.instruction: Add another 1 volume of the same bead solution (beads prepared as above) to the DNA solution, mix, and repeat purity/integrity assessment.
